title: Tailwind Configuration Setup
ques: Explain the role of **`tailwind.config.js`** in configuring template file scanning paths (`content`) and extending core design tokens.
explanation: The `content` array defines which source files Tailwind's JIT (Just-In-Time) compiler scans to generate only the exact CSS classes used in the project, keeping production bundle sizes tiny.

title: Theme Extension: Custom Colors and Fonts
ques: Write a `tailwind.config.js` theme block that extends the design system with a custom brand color palette (`brand: { 500: '#6366f1', 600: '#4f46e5' }`) and a custom Google Font (`'Inter'`).
explanation: Adding custom values under `theme.extend` preserves all default Tailwind colors and fonts while adding new tokens like `bg-brand-500` or `font-display`.

title: Using Arbitrary Values with Square Brackets
ques: Demonstrate the use of **Arbitrary Values** in Tailwind for one-off pixel values, CSS variables, and dynamic grid layouts without editing config files.

answer.content:
Custom Metric Widget

Arbitrary values allow precise one-off overrides while retaining the convenience of inline utility composition.

explanation: Square bracket notation (`w-[350px]`, `bg-[#ff3366]`) enables Tailwind's JIT compiler to generate custom on-the-fly CSS classes without needing custom config definitions.

title: CSS Directives: @tailwind, @apply, and @layer
ques: Explain the role of the `@tailwind`, `@layer`, and `@apply` directives in your main CSS file. Provide an example creating a reusable button component.
explanation: `@layer components` groups custom component classes so utility classes can still override them. `@apply` inlines existing utility styles into a single reusable CSS class.

title: Extending Functionality with Tailwind Plugins
ques: Explain how official plugins like `@tailwindcss/forms` and `@tailwindcss/typography` improve developer productivity. Show how to register them in `tailwind.config.js`.
explanation: Tailwind plugins inject predefined component suites and utility sets. For instance, the typography plugin provides the `.prose` class to format CMS markdown content automatically.
